title: Ladies’ Day Attendees Sign-up

body: Please fill out the form to register for Ladies’ Day. Should you have any questions, please contact Shelley Cohen at swladiesday@gmail.com

items: Attire: White or Club Shirts with collars, white bottoms

sections.alt: 2026 Ladies’ Day schedule of dates and host clubs.

formSpec.purpose: Registers a bowler (and optionally her team) for a specific Ladies’ Day event on the season schedule.

fields.label: Name
fields.notes: First name and last name sub-inputs, both shown and both required.

fields.label: Email
fields.notes: No mailing-list opt-in, no email verification.

fields.label: Please choose the Ladies' Day event you are signing up for from the dropdown menu
Please enter the name and positions of each player.
fields.description: Please use this space to enter each name of the players with their positions. i.e. Anne - Skip.

formSpec.notes: Squarespace form block, formId 68e80829a90bf9308aff8509, form name "Detailed Contact Form". CAPTCHA enabled. Inline success message "Thank you!", no redirect. No payment is taken — the $5 entry fee is paid in person on arrival. Where submissions are stored is not exposed in the page HTML; check the Squarespace form's Storage tab (Shelley Cohen / swladiesday@gmail.com is the likely recipient).

migrationNotes: The Squarespace form itself was not migrated — see formSpec.
The event dropdown options are the 2026 Ladies’ Day schedule and will need updating each season.
The sign-up form is now a Google Form; responses go to its linked spreadsheet. To change the questions, edit the form in Google Forms - nothing here needs changing.
